workstreams.title: Java 25 reactor build and regression failures
workstreams.owner: pom.xml; existing Maven starter test source; .github/workflows
workstreams.flow: Every Maven module compiles and executes tests; no skipped tests to hide failures
workstreams.accept: Green Java 25 full-reactor compile and test CI; no unresolved errors, evidence matrix per module

workstreams.title: Facility isolation, OIDC roles, consent and audit
workstreams.flow: Cross-tenant read/modify attempts denied; verified JWT facility memberships; consent/break-glass audited
workstreams.accept: Real HTTP/JWT negative tests; no trust in X-Facility-Id alone; post-transaction tenant cleanup

workstreams.title: Canonical patient identity and visit journey
workstreams.flow: Returning patient match→one patient ID→new encounter→triage→consultation→results→disposition
workstreams.accept: PostgreSQL integration with repeated arrival; no duplicate patient or encounter; ordered audit trail

workstreams.title: Queue management and financial activation
workstreams.flow: Check-in→triage priorities→service queue→payment/insurance hold→release; emergency bypass
workstreams.accept: Parallel queue and payment concurrency, idempotent replays, restart recovery and no billing barrier to emergency stabilization

workstreams.title: Clinical order/result/notification event orchestration
workstreams.flow: Signed lab/imaging/Rx order→automatic department task→signed result→inbox→clinical acknowledgment
workstreams.accept: Real durable event-outbox tests; no manual calls between service stages, no notification counted delivered without provider proof

workstreams.title: Standalone pharmacy example — complete operational flow
workstreams.flow: Supplier→PO→receipt→batch→FEFO→prescription validation→dispense→stock ledger; quarantine/recall
workstreams.accept: Real PostgreSQL Testcontainers flow, clinic/hospital module isolation, controlled drug witness and payment opt-in negative tests

workstreams.title: Standalone diagnostic laboratory example — complete LIS flow
workstreams.flow: Referral→order→specimen barcode→QC→analyzer/result→verification→critical-result escalation→release
workstreams.accept: Persisted order-to-result workflow with failures for bad specimen/QC, clinician receipt proof, LIS-only pack isolation

workstreams.title: Standalone radiology center example — complete RIS flow
workstreams.flow: Referral→worklist→appointment→DICOM study→acquisition→signed report→critical acknowledgment→amendment
workstreams.accept: Real DB flows, no fake PACS binary features, PACS-off 501 and tenant/consent negative tests

workstreams.title: Standalone pharmaceutical manufacturing example
workstreams.flow: Approved formula→materials quarantine/QC→weigh witness→eBMR→IPC→QC/QA release→serialization→recall
workstreams.accept: Persistence, dual approvals, deviation/CAPA, lot genealogy and release-blocking tests; zero patient/EMR dependencies

workstreams.title: Standalone life-sciences LIMS/ELN example
workstreams.flow: Research protocol approval→scientific sample accession→experiment/ELN→instrument results→review→dataset provenance
workstreams.accept: Scientific non-patient sample and instrument lineage persisted with immutable review and independent sample tests

workstreams.title: Standalone biobank example
workstreams.flow: Consent→biospecimen intake→aliquot genealogy→storage temp→approved request→release; withdrawal
workstreams.accept: Real inventory/aliquot and chain-of-custody tests, withdrawal blocks re-release, no orphan aliquots

workstreams.title: Standalone clinical research / CRO example
workstreams.flow: Protocol→IRB/ethics→screening→eConsent→eCRF queries→AE→PI signoff→approved export
workstreams.accept: Real study participant and eCRF lifecycle, privacy review gates, no unsupported regulatory-certification claims

workstreams.title: Standalone outpatient EMR example
workstreams.flow: Existing patient→triage/vitals→consultation/SOAP→orders/Rx→results reviewed→follow-up/discharge
workstreams.accept: Real multi-visit DB test and clinically supervised safety/authorization gates; no duplicate patient IDs

workstreams.title: Standalone longitudinal EHR example
workstreams.flow: Import two clinical histories→provenance→consent→reconciliation/conflict→patient access→authorized summary export
workstreams.accept: Real record versioning and provenance assertions; cross-facility source attribution and privacy segmentation tests

workstreams.title: Standalone HIS/reference host example
workstreams.flow: Registration→triage→payment policy→consultation→lab, imaging and pharmacy in parallel→clinician review→admit/discharge
workstreams.accept: PostgreSQL integration with automatic queues/events, critical result escalation, billing exceptions and restart recovery

workstreams.title: Standalone regional HIE example
workstreams.flow: Partner onboarding→trusted identity match→consent→HL7/FHIR→DocumentReference→ACK/DLQ→audit
workstreams.accept: Tenant-scoped R4/HL7 transaction, replay/idempotency and unauthorized export negative tests, no HIS inpatient dependencies

workstreams.title: Android/iOS KMP offline clinical SDK
workstreams.flow: Encrypted local chart→offline edit→conflict quarantine→auth renewal→sync→device revocation
workstreams.accept: Android compile + real encrypted DB tests, iOS compilation on macOS, no silent default normal vitals or partial 5-rights checks

workstreams.title: Database migrations, pack dependency isolation and release CI
workstreams.flow: Install each pack alone→migrate→persist→restart→upgrade→rollback/restore→clean tenant isolation
workstreams.accept: Postgres16, SQLServer, MySQL execution evidence, all 8 packs independent, restore tests and generated evidence manifest

workstreams.title: Clinical specialty, public-health and operational safety coverage
workstreams.owner: blood-bank; surgery-ot; emergency-nursing; workforce-roster; chw-homecare; disease-surveillance; public-health
workstreams.flow: Credential gates, transfusion mismatch, WHO surgical checklist, NEWS2 escalation, homecare referral, IDSR alert, vaccination recall
workstreams.accept: Independent clinical rule test fixtures, exception routes, tenant guards, no clinical certification without signed reviewer

workstreams.title: Documentation, README, integration and release evidence
workstreams.flow: New developer picks pack→installs deps→starts synthetic environment→runs real workflow→finds OpenAPI, forms, reports and troubleshooting
workstreams.accept: Every one of 11 examples documents executable commands and real test outputs; remove overclaims, reconcile API paths, maintain clear release matrix

examples.workflow: Supplier receipt → batch/FEFO → prescription validation → dispense → stock decrement → recall

examples.workflow: Referral → schedule/worklist → DICOM study metadata → acquisition → signed report → clinician review

examples.workflow: Master formula approval → material weigh/quarantine → eBMR → IPC → QA release → serialization

examples.workflow: Ethics-approved project → nonpatient sample → experiment/ELN → instrument/QC → release

examples.workflow: Protocol/ethics → eConsent → eligibility → visits/eCRF → queries/SAE → PI sign → export

examples.workflow: Patient identity match → visit/triage → SOAP → CPOE/Rx → results review → disposition
examples.negative: Duplicate identities; critical results; emergency bypass; unauthorized order

examples.workflow: Cross-provider history import → provenance → reconciliation → authorized access → export
examples.negative: Patient matching conflicts; provenance; consent segmentation

examples.workflow: Arrival → triage → consultation/payment → parallel lab/RIS/pharmacy → clinician review → discharge
examples.negative: Financial hold exceptions; queue ordering; lost events; concurrent fulfillment

examples.workflow: Partner trust → patient discover → consent → HL7/FHIR → ACK/DLQ → audit
